resources.string: Keeps speed, trip and weather while another app covers the car screen or the phone is locked.

Some phones (especially China-market models and makers that restrict background apps) cut off location while FermataX runs on the car screen. For a stable speed card, trip and weather, also allow location “Allow all the time”. Your location stays on your phone. You can allow it now or later in Settings.
Android still allows FermataX to use location all the time. Open app permission settings to change it to “Allow only while using the app”?
Location permission “Allow all the time” was not granted.
Location is allowed all the time.
Allow location “Allow all the time” to keep the speed card and trip active.
